RFC4180_RAW_PRESERVATION.description: Logical record text slice preserved with exact raw bytes; no unescaping of "" to " in audit raw slice.

ROW_TARGET_LINKAGE_1_TO_1.description: Enforce 1:1 row-to-target linkage; every target executed in campaign queue is linked to a source row in HistoryStore.

PRE_SUBMIT_STATE_DISTINCTION.description: Attempt stays in PREPARING during navigation/scanning; transitions to SUBMIT_PENDING immediately before START_SENDING.

PRE_SUBMIT_FAILURE_RETRYABLE.description: Pre-submit failure settles as FAILURE with reason PRE_SUBMIT_PERSISTENCE_FAILED; SW restart during PREPARING settles as FAILURE INTERRUPTED_PREPARING; target is not suppressed and remains retryable.

UNIFIED_FORM_TEMPLATE_V2_SCHEMA.description: Unified record schema with both flat accessors (firstName, lastName, email, phone, company, website, subject, message, fullName) and nested objects (sender, content).

AUTHORITATIVE_TEMPLATES_V2.description: templates_v2 authoritative across all save/edit paths; saveTemplate awaits _syncTemplateToV2.

LEGACY_FIXTURE_POPUP_MAPPING.description: Migrated legacy templates verified through direct popup input field extraction.

PRODUCTION_FUNCTION_TESTING.description: Integration test directly invokes production restoreCampaignState and HistoryStore methods.

PACKAGE_INVENTORY_SHA256.description: Deterministic SHA-256 manifest covering all files in the package.

COMMIT_PROVENANCE.description: Provenance artifacts tying package bytes to Git commit SHA 9d6afff048c0fd1b31a2ff433ea37561079a1f3f.
